source.quote: Our frontier-class multimodal model optimized for agentic and coding use cases. Released as open weights under a Modified MIT license.

findings.text: Open weights are released under a Modified MIT license, with a Hugging Face weights link on the card.

notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/mistral-medium-3-5-26-04, redirects to /models/mistral-medium-3-5-26-04). It is a product/model catalog page (release date, context, license, params, features, pricing), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Weights table values (Parameters/Active 128, context 256k) come from the page HTML/RSC and the same-site model catalog used to render the page. Capabilities in that catalog also list input text/image and output reasoning/text, but modalities are recorded only as the page's word 'multimodal' because icon-only modality labels were not available as plain text. Benchmark numbers on Hugging Face (e.g. τ³-Telecom 91.4%, SWE-Bench Verified 77.6%) and the blog post were not used; seed-lookup listed only this document for the card. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
